reviews.text:
I am incredibly grateful for the thorough and careful examinations I receive every time.

My cats are precious family members to me. The veterinarian understands this and always considers what is best for patients who cannot speak for themselves.

I am truly thankful to have found a veterinary hospital where I can entrust my beloved family members with complete peace of mind.

Please call to make a reservation! Reservations are required due to the effects of COVID-19.

Thank you for your love for animals and consideration for pet owners. If you're struggling to find a hospital and don't want to regret your choice, this is the place. m(_ _)m You can rest assured that your pet will be admitted here safely. The examination was thorough, and it seems they even cleaned my pet's teeth before surgery, leaving them beautiful. It's completely different from the hospitals I've been to before. The consultation fees are also very reasonable.

We rushed in just when it seemed too late and they saved our pet, and we talk about how glad we are every day. The doctors and nurses work incredibly hard every day, even with their hair disheveled. This is the third hospital I've tried, and it's a very important one for me. If possible, I'd like to move closer. By the way, my dogs walk ahead and try to open the door for me, which is quite a surprise!

Due to its popularity, be prepared for a wait depending on the time of day.

Please check the website.

Currently, it seems they are not offering nighttime consultations due to the doctors' health management.

If you notice anything even slightly different than usual, whether it's during a walk or after eating treats, please bring your pet in for a check-up as soon as possible!

They had Antinol!

Since then,
they're now 17 and 18 years old. They had major surgery where their internal organs were thoroughly cleaned. They had surgery at 10 and have lived for 7 years since. And this year, they almost died again, but just seeing the doctor's face made both of them feel better on the way home. It seems to reassure them m(_ _)m
The nurses are also incredibly efficient, which is rare. I cycle for an hour to get there.

It's a truly worthwhile animal hospital.

If you're worried about your pet, please go to Bambi no Mori Animal Hospital!

The doctor here is very kind, gentle, and polite.
However, as others have mentioned, the quality of the female staff is terrible.
(This applies to only certain individuals; not all female staff are like this.)
I don't know what the problem is, but they always look angry and their attitude is cold.
I cannot entrust my beloved family to a place where women like this work.
Also, I had an appointment for 9:00 AM, the opening time, and waited outside the hospital from 8:55 AM, five minutes before opening.
However, the entrance didn't open even after 9:00 AM. After waiting for several minutes, the door was opened as if nothing had happened.
I understand that there may be circumstances that prevent them from opening on time.
However, I was furious that they didn't say a word and acted so dismissively.
I'm sure the doctor is a kind person, so he probably can't speak strongly to the staff.
However, they need to realize that this is causing unpleasant experiences for customers.
Kindness isn't the only important thing.

I have never met such a kind and gentle doctor. We have two pets, and they have been incredibly well cared for. As others have mentioned, the wait is indeed long. However, once you and your pet are called into the examination room and speak with the doctor, you understand why the wait is so long. They listen carefully and gently to each and every patient. They never force medication or injections on you, and even though they must get tired from such thorough examinations, they have never treated our pets roughly or rushed through the process. I hope this hospital and these doctors continue to operate for a long time. I don't think I could find a better hospital than this... Thank you so much for everything.
Even if you make an appointment, it's pointless because they will only see patients who arrive first.
I'm really grateful for all your help! The best thing is that I can trust the teacher with anything, even when it's busy!
They seem to be kind to pet cats, but I heard that they are cold towards stray cats, giving orders in a bossy manner and treating them like dirt, so I stopped using them. I don't recommend TNR.

The doctor is very kind and has been very helpful. However, the receptionist's way of speaking is a little one-sided and her expression is stiff, so I always think that if she were a little more empathetic, it would ease my anxiety.

My two cats are always taken care of here.
The kind doctors and nurses are soothing.

→Updated May 2025
Four years later, I'm still so grateful for their care.
Even though I travel a little far,
it's a hospital that's worth the trip.

I've been to this hospital several times because it has great reviews, but the fact that it's a little far from my home was a bit of a downside.
However, when I lost one of my pets to illness at the end of last year, I became distrustful of the previous veterinary hospital and have now completely transferred to this one.
Here,
They not only call the owner by their name, but also call each pet they bring in with their first name,
and are incredibly kind and greet them every time.
They also treat animals with such gentleness,
and listen carefully to what owners have to say and make various suggestions.
At my previous hospital, I consulted about dementia,
and even told them I was worried about kidney disease, but they wouldn't prescribe any medication. Very elderly pets require a lot of attention, and owners want them to stay healthy and live as long as possible.
The nighttime cries caused by dementia are mentally and physically demanding.
I appreciate their understanding.
While kidney disease is inevitable, they did their best to help maintain the status quo as much as possible.
I also think the bill is generally reasonable.

They're open late, even on weekends.
It's easily accessible, taking a taxi there but taking the train from Minamimorimachi Station on the way back.

My cat tends to be intimidating towards men, but for some reason, he shows no intimidation towards the doctor at this hospital. Of course, he is nervous because it is a hospital, but he seems to be relatively calm during the examination. There must be something about animals that he can understand. He is a very relaxed and calm doctor who is good at dealing with my beloved cat.
I'm grateful for the appropriate treatment.

I was introduced to this doctor by a milk volunteer and had my 8-month-old cat's eyes checked. 
The doctor spoke to the cat gently while observing its condition and explained any symptoms in detail. 

Of course, it's better to bring records of vaccinations etc. with you so that it makes filling out the medical questionnaire easier!
The doctor is always so kind and helpful; this is a truly wonderful hospital! Thank you so much as always.
My dog ​​is always examined very carefully. He seems to really love the vet! 😁 …

My cats are being cared for here.
I've been to many hospitals in the past, but I never quite found one that felt right. But this hospital was the best in terms of the time it took to get to my appointment, the treatment provided, and the attitude of the doctors and staff.
Even during the appointment, I could feel their kindness toward animals.
Although I have to drive a long way, I'll continue to use their services. <(_ _)>

This hospital also focuses on TNR, and I often see cages with cats in nets. There are also many posters for adoption events!
I'm humbled by the help they've given to so many cats, and knowing that this hospital is trusted by rescue cats and those involved in TNR activities gives me even more peace of mind.

This was my first time visiting, so I spoke to them over the phone, but the nurse's attitude was so rude I was shocked. It was the first time I'd ever been treated so badly. I understand they were busy, but it was obvious they wanted to hang up quickly, and they almost hung up on me even though I wasn't convinced. 

("I'm having surgery soon, so I can't keep you on the phone," they said, which is very cruel, and they used various other phrases to explain why they wanted to hang up quickly.) I understand they were busy, but their attitude was so rude I was saddened.

I'm going to report this to the consumer center or another national agency because their phone service is so bad, so could you please tell me the name and surname of the woman who spoke to me?

When I told them I couldn't ask for advice without knowing who spoke to me, they completely ignored me (which I felt was malicious) and insisted they would ask the doctor and please wait a moment. What were they asking me? I'm already consulting the consultation center, so it's fine, just tell me who spoke to me. They stubbornly refused to tell me my surname or anything else, and put me on hold.

I was shocked by how badly the nurse treated me. As someone who works in the service industry myself, I find this treatment extremely awful and saddening.

I've already consulted the consumer protection center, but it seems that cases like this are left to the store owner or clinic director to handle. If the clinic director or owner is reading this review, I would appreciate it if you could take a closer look at the training of your nurses. Sorry for the long message.

Thank you for taking such good care of my cat. The vet is very good with cats, explains things clearly, performs thorough examinations, and seems very kind. I also appreciate that they are open late. Since it's by appointment only, if you …
The teacher is kind and caring towards animals.

I rescued two kittens from a nearby area and was referred to this hospital by a rescue organization. I made an appointment, but they were able to examine me in no time. The doctor was kind, so I felt at ease with my two kittens.
